title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
abstract_short: RAG combines a pre-trained seq2seq model (BART) with a dense retriever (DPR) over Wikipedia, enabling retrieval-augmented generation for knowledge-intensive NLP tasks.

title: REALM: Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Pre-Training
abstract_short: REALM augments language model pre-training with a latent knowledge retriever, jointly training retrieval and prediction using masked language modeling over Wikipedia.

title: Improving Language Models by Retrieving from Trillions of Tokens
abstract_short: RETRO retrieves from a 2T token database using chunked cross-attention, achieving GPT-3 comparable performance with 25x fewer parameters.

title: Atlas: Few-shot Learning with Retrieval Augmented Language Models
abstract_short: Atlas is a retrieval-augmented language model that achieves strong few-shot performance, reaching 42% on NaturalQuestions with only 64 examples, outperforming a 540B parameter model.

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
abstract_short: Self-RAG trains a single LM to adaptively retrieve passages on-demand and self-reflect using special reflection tokens, improving factuality and citation accuracy.

title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
abstract_short: CRAG uses a lightweight retrieval evaluator to assess document quality and triggers corrective retrieval actions, with a decompose-then-recompose algorithm to filter irrelevant information.

title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
abstract_short: FLARE iteratively predicts upcoming content, uses low-confidence predictions as queries to retrieve relevant documents, and regenerates sentences for improved factuality.

title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
abstract_short: DPR demonstrates that dense representations learned by a simple dual-encoder framework outperform BM25 by 9-19% on open-domain QA passage retrieval.

title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
abstract_short: Toolformer trains LMs in a self-supervised way to decide which APIs to call, when to call them, and how to incorporate results, using a calculator, Q&A, search, translation, and calendar.

title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted Question-answering with Human Feedback
abstract_short: WebGPT fine-tunes GPT-3 to answer long-form questions using a text-based web browser, trained with imitation learning and human feedback, collecting references while browsing.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
abstract_short: ReAct interleaves reasoning traces and task-specific actions in LLMs, enabling reasoning to guide action plans and actions to gather information from external sources.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract_short: Chain-of-thought prompting enables LLMs to perform complex reasoning by generating intermediate reasoning steps, emerging naturally in sufficiently large models.

title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
abstract_short: Self-consistency replaces greedy decoding in CoT by sampling diverse reasoning paths and selecting the most consistent answer via majority voting, boosting GSM8K by 17.9%.

title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
abstract_short: ToT generalizes CoT by exploring multiple reasoning paths as a tree, using self-evaluation and search algorithms (BFS/DFS), solving 74% of Game of 24 vs 4% for CoT.

title: Graph of Thoughts: Solving Elaborate Problems with Large Language Models
abstract_short: GoT models LLM reasoning as an arbitrary graph where thoughts are vertices and edges are dependencies, enabling combining, refining, and backtracking beyond linear/tree structures.

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
abstract_short: Voyager is the first LLM-powered embodied lifelong learning agent in Minecraft with automatic curriculum, skill library of executable code, and iterative prompting with environment feedback.

title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
abstract_short: Generative agents simulate believable human behavior using an architecture that stores experiences in natural language, synthesizes reflections, and retrieves memories to plan behavior in a sandbox environment.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
abstract_short: Reflexion reinforces language agents through linguistic feedback rather than weight updates, maintaining reflective text in episodic memory to improve decision-making across trials.

title: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning Acting and Planning in Language Models
abstract_short: LATS synergizes reasoning, acting, and planning by integrating Monte Carlo Tree Search with LM-powered value functions and self-reflections, achieving 92.7% on HumanEval.

title: HuggingGPT: Solving AI Tasks with ChatGPT and its Friends in Hugging Face
abstract_short: HuggingGPT uses ChatGPT as a controller to plan tasks, select expert models from Hugging Face, execute subtasks, and summarize results for complex AI task solving.

title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs
abstract_short: ToolLLM provides a framework with ToolBench dataset of 16,464 real-world APIs, depth-first search decision tree algorithm, and ToolEval evaluator for LLM tool mastery.

title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs
abstract_short: Gorilla is a finetuned LLaMA model that surpasses GPT-4 on API call generation, using Retriever Aware Training to adapt to document changes and reduce hallucination.

title: QA-GNN: Reasoning with Language Models and Knowledge Graphs for Question Answering
abstract_short: QA-GNN jointly reasons over language context and knowledge graphs by connecting QA context and KG into a joint graph with relevance scoring and GNN-based mutual updates.

title: GreaseLM: Graph REASoning Enhanced Language Models for Question Answering
abstract_short: GreaseLM fuses language model and graph neural network representations through multiple layers of modality interaction, outperforming models 8x larger on CommonsenseQA and MedQA.

title: Think-on-Graph: Deep and Responsible Reasoning of Large Language Model on Knowledge Graph
abstract_short: ToG treats LLM as an agent to interactively explore KG entities and relations using beam search, enabling traceable reasoning that can outperform GPT-4 with smaller models.

title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning
abstract_short: RoG synergizes LLMs with KGs via a planning-retrieval-reasoning framework, generating KG-grounded relation paths as plans and retrieving valid reasoning paths for faithful inference.

title: G-Retriever: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Textual Graph Understanding and Question Answering
abstract_short: G-Retriever introduces RAG for textual graphs using Prize-Collecting Steiner Tree optimization to resist hallucination and handle graphs exceeding LLM context windows.

title: Knowledge Neurons in Pretrained Transformers
abstract_short: Identifies knowledge neurons in transformer FFN layers that express specific factual knowledge, enabling knowledge editing (update, erase) without fine-tuning via Integrated Gradients attribution.

title: Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT
abstract_short: ROME locates factual associations in mid-layer feed-forward modules of GPT and edits them via rank-one updates, enabling targeted counterfactual knowledge insertion with specificity and generalization.

title: Mass-Editing Memory in a Transformer
abstract_short: MEMIT scales knowledge editing to thousands of associations simultaneously by targeting multi-layer feed-forward weights, extending ROME's approach to mass memory updates.

title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
abstract_short: FActScore decomposes generated text into atomic facts and computes the percentage supported by a reliable knowledge source, with an automated estimator achieving <2% error vs human evaluation.

title: TruthfulQA: Measuring How Models Mimic Human Falsehoods
abstract_short: TruthfulQA benchmarks LLM truthfulness with 817 questions across 38 categories where humans commonly err; the best model achieves 58% vs 94% human performance.

title: A Survey on Hallucination in Large Language Models: Principles, Taxonomy, Challenges, and Open Questions
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey of LLM hallucination covering principles, detection methods and benchmarks, mitigation strategies, and open questions with a detailed taxonomy.

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
abstract_short: SWE-bench evaluates LLMs on 2,294 real software engineering tasks from GitHub issues across 12 Python repositories, requiring codebase editing to resolve issues.

title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
abstract_short: SWE-agent designs custom agent-computer interfaces (ACI) for LM agents to autonomously navigate repositories, edit code, and run tests, achieving 12.5% on SWE-bench.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
abstract_short: Codex is a GPT model fine-tuned on GitHub code, solving 28.8% of HumanEval problems; introduces the HumanEval benchmark of 164 programming tasks for functional correctness evaluation.

title: GPT-4 Technical Report
abstract_short: GPT-4 is a large-scale multimodal model accepting image and text inputs, exhibiting human-level performance on professional benchmarks including passing the bar exam in the top 10%.

title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
abstract_short: InstructGPT aligns GPT-3 with user intent via RLHF: supervised fine-tuning on demonstrations, reward model training on rankings, and PPO optimization. 1.3B InstructGPT preferred over 175B GPT-3.

title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
abstract_short: Constitutional AI trains harmless AI assistants without human labels for harmful outputs, using self-critique and revision (supervised) and RL from AI Feedback (RLAIF) guided by a constitution of principles.

title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
abstract_short: Self-Refine uses a single LLM to iteratively generate, provide feedback, and refine outputs without any training, improving task performance by ~20% absolute on average.

title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
abstract_short: CRITIC enables LLMs to validate and amend outputs by interacting with external tools for verification, then revising based on tool feedback, improving QA, math, and toxicity reduction.

title: ART: Automatic multi-step reasoning and tool-use for large language models
abstract_short: ART automatically generates multi-step reasoning programs with tool calls by selecting demonstrations from a task library, matching hand-crafted CoT on BigBench and MMLU.

title: Chameleon: Plug-and-Play Compositional Reasoning with Large Language Models
abstract_short: Chameleon uses an LLM-based planner to compose various tools (vision models, search, Python, etc.) for compositional reasoning, achieving 86.54% on ScienceQA with GPT-4.

title: An LLM Compiler for Parallel Function Calling
abstract_short: LLMCompiler orchestrates parallel function execution via a Function Calling Planner, Task Fetching Unit, and Executor, achieving up to 3.7x latency speedup over ReAct.

title: A Survey on Large Language Model based Autonomous Agents
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey of LLM-based autonomous agents covering construction (profiling, memory, planning, action), applications (social/natural/engineering science), and evaluation strategies.

title: Unifying Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: A Roadmap
abstract_short: Roadmap for LLM-KG unification covering three frameworks: KG-enhanced LLMs (augmenting pre-training/inference), LLM-augmented KGs (construction/completion), and Synergized LLM+KG systems.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
abstract_short: Comprehensive RAG survey covering Naive RAG, Advanced RAG, and Modular RAG paradigms, examining retrieval, generation, and augmentation techniques with evaluation frameworks.

title: Grammar-Constrained Decoding for Structured NLP Tasks without Finetuning
abstract_short: Grammar-constrained decoding guides LLM generation to follow formal grammars (CFG/JSON schema) at inference time without finetuning, ensuring structured output compliance.

title: Knowledge-Augmented Language Model Prompting for Zero-Shot Knowledge Graph Question Answering
abstract_short: KAPING retrieves relevant KG facts via semantic similarity and prepends them as prompts to LLMs for zero-shot KGQA, outperforming baselines by up to 48%.

title: RAT: Retrieval Augmented Thoughts Elicit Context-Aware Reasoning in Long-Horizon Generation
abstract_short: RAT iteratively revises each CoT reasoning step with retrieved information relevant to the query and prior steps, improving code generation by 13.6% and math reasoning by 17%.

title: The Impact of AI on Developer Productivity: Evidence from GitHub Copilot
abstract_short: Randomized controlled trial with 95 professional programmers showing GitHub Copilot users completed tasks 55.8% faster, providing first causal evidence of AI coding assistant productivity gains.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Specification
abstract_short: MCP is an open protocol standardizing LLM-tool integration via client-server architecture with JSON-RPC, defining Tools, Resources, and Prompts primitives to solve the MxN integration problem.

title: AutoGPT: An Autonomous GPT-4 Experiment
abstract_short: AutoGPT is one of the first autonomous AI agent systems using GPT-4, breaking complex tasks into subtasks with self-generated prompts, showcasing autonomous goal-directed behavior.

title: BabyAGI: Task-Driven Autonomous Agent
abstract_short: BabyAGI implements a task creation-execution-prioritization loop using LLMs and vector memory, one of the first open-source autonomous agents with task planning capability.

title: Instruction Tuning for Large Language Models: A Survey
abstract_short: Survey of instruction tuning methodology, dataset construction, model training, and applications across modalities and domains, covering FLAN, InstructGPT, and successors.

title: KnowledGPT: Enhancing Large Language Models with Retrieval and Storage Access on Knowledge Bases
abstract_short: KnowledGPT bridges LLMs with knowledge bases using program-of-thought prompting for retrieval and storage, generating search code with pre-defined KB operation functions.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
definition: Architecture pattern that combines information retrieval from external knowledge sources with neural text generation, enabling LLMs to access up-to-date or domain-specific knowledge beyond their training data.

title: Dense Passage Retrieval
definition: Technique using learned dense vector representations (embeddings) from dual-encoder models to retrieve relevant passages, replacing sparse keyword-based methods like BM25.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
definition: Prompting technique that elicits step-by-step intermediate reasoning from LLMs before producing a final answer, dramatically improving performance on complex reasoning tasks.

title: Tool Use / Function Calling in LLMs
definition: Capability of LLMs to invoke external tools, APIs, or functions during generation, extending their abilities beyond text to include computation, search, code execution, and more.

title: LLM-based Autonomous Agent
definition: System using an LLM as a central controller for perception, reasoning, planning, and action execution, often with memory modules and tool access to accomplish complex tasks autonomously.

title: Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA)
definition: Task of answering natural language questions by reasoning over structured knowledge graphs, often combining graph neural networks or graph traversal with language models.

title: Knowledge Editing in LLMs
definition: Methods for directly modifying specific factual associations stored in LLM parameters without full retraining, targeting localized computations in feed-forward layers.

title: Hallucination Detection and Mitigation
definition: Techniques for identifying and reducing factually incorrect, unsupported, or fabricated content generated by LLMs, including retrieval augmentation, self-verification, and atomic fact evaluation.

title: Self-Reflection in LLM Agents
definition: Mechanism where LLM agents evaluate their own outputs, generate verbal feedback, and use it to iteratively improve responses or decision-making across episodes.

title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
definition: Training methodology that aligns LLM outputs with human preferences using reward models trained on human rankings, then optimizing the LLM via reinforcement learning (typically PPO).

title: Structured Output / Constrained Decoding
definition: Methods ensuring LLM outputs conform to predefined formats (JSON, XML, grammars) by constraining token selection during decoding, enabling reliable integration with downstream systems.

title: Reasoning Paradigms (CoT, ToT, GoT)
definition: Family of prompting and inference strategies that structure LLM reasoning as chains (sequential), trees (branching with backtracking), or graphs (arbitrary dependencies between thoughts).

title: Embodied LLM Agent
definition: LLM-powered agents that interact with virtual or physical environments, learning skills through exploration, feedback, and code generation for open-ended task completion.

title: Agent-Computer Interface (ACI)
definition: Specialized interfaces designed for LLM agents to interact with computer environments (file systems, terminals, browsers), optimizing for agent rather than human usability.

title: Factuality Evaluation for LLMs
definition: Benchmarks and metrics for measuring the factual accuracy of LLM generations, including atomic fact decomposition, knowledge-source verification, and truthfulness scoring.

title: Multi-Agent LLM Systems
definition: Architectures where multiple LLM-based agents collaborate, debate, or specialize in different roles to solve complex tasks, often with shared memory and communication protocols.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Pre-training
definition: Pre-training paradigm that jointly trains a retriever and language model, enabling the model to learn to retrieve and reason over external knowledge during the pre-training phase.

title: LLM and Knowledge Graph Integration
definition: Approaches combining LLMs with structured knowledge graphs for enhanced reasoning, including KG-enhanced LLMs, LLM-augmented KGs, and synergized systems.

title: LLM Code Generation
definition: Application of LLMs to automatically generate, complete, debug, and reason about source code, evaluated via benchmarks like HumanEval and SWE-bench.

title: Agentic Coding Assistants
definition: AI coding tools that go beyond autocomplete to autonomously navigate codebases, plan multi-file changes, run tests, and resolve real software engineering tasks.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
definition: Open standard by Anthropic for LLM-tool integration using client-server architecture with JSON-RPC, providing Tools, Resources, and Prompts primitives for standardized agent-tool communication.

title: Iterative/Active Retrieval
definition: RAG variants that dynamically decide when and what to retrieve during generation based on confidence signals, rather than retrieving only once before generation.

title: Knowledge Neurons
definition: Specific neurons in transformer feed-forward layers whose activation correlates with expression of particular factual knowledge, identified via gradient-based attribution methods.

title: Verbal Reinforcement Learning
definition: Agent learning paradigm where feedback and experience are stored as natural language reflections rather than numeric rewards, enabling learning without weight updates.

title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for LLM Planning
definition: Adaptation of MCTS algorithms for LLM agent planning, using LM-generated value estimates and self-reflections to guide exploration of action-reasoning trees.
